rules.title: Open incidents without an assignee
rules.recommendation: Review assignment rules and group membership for the affected categories; sample the unassigned population by category and source.

rules.title: Significant open-incident ageing beyond 30 days
rules.recommendation: Review the aged population by assignment group and state; confirm escalation notifications and SLA visibility.

rules.title: Duplicate incident signatures detected
rules.recommendation: Review the top duplicate short-description clusters; add correlation or de-duplication on the creating integration.

rules.title: No active SLA definitions
rules.recommendation: Confirm whether SLAs are in scope; if so, activate or create the required contract_sla definitions.

rules.title: SLAs are not attaching to a large share of new incidents
causes: Wrong task table on the definition
rules.recommendation: Validate definition active flags, start conditions, task table, schedule and retroactive settings against a sample of recent incidents without task_sla records.

rules.title: High SLA breach ratio
rules.recommendation: Review breach distribution by definition; confirm targets, schedules and pause conditions with the process owner.

rules.title: Open changes without a risk assessment
causes: Risk assessment not mandatory in the change model
rules.recommendation: Confirm the change models enforce risk calculation before authorisation; review the affected population.

rules.title: Change approvals pending for more than 7 days
rules.recommendation: Review pending approvals by approver; add reminder notifications and delegation rules.

rules.title: High emergency change ratio
causes: Normal change lead time too slow
rules.recommendation: Review emergency change justifications; consider standard change candidates and lead-time improvements.

rules.title: Active catalog items without a fulfilment process
causes: Items migrated without their delivery process
rules.recommendation: Attach a Flow Designer flow or workflow to each affected item, or retire items that are no longer offered.

rules.title: Requests may not be generating requested items
causes: Custom request creation path bypassing sc_req_item
rules.recommendation: Sample recent sc_request records without RITMs; review order guides, cart client scripts and any custom request creation integrations.

rules.title: Requested items ageing beyond 30 days
rules.recommendation: Cross-reference with pending approvals and unassigned catalog tasks; review stuck flow contexts for the top items.

rules.title: Open problems without an assignee
causes: Problems raised from incident without triage
rules.recommendation: Establish a problem intake and ownership model; review the unassigned population.

rules.title: Problems open beyond 90 days
causes: Known errors never closed against fixes
rules.recommendation: Review aged problems for closure or conversion to known errors with workarounds documented.

rules.title: CIs stored on the cmdb_ci base class
causes: Manual creation from the base table
rules.recommendation: Identify the creation source of base-class CIs and reclassify them; correct the creating import/integration.

rules.title: CIs without a name
causes: Identification on other keys with name never populated
rules.recommendation: Trace the creation path of unnamed CIs and correct the mapping; consider a data-certification rule for name.

rules.title: High duplicate server CI ratio
rules.recommendation: Review server identification rules and datasource precedence; profile the duplicate clusters by creation source before any merge.

rules.title: Duplicate hardware serial numbers
rules.recommendation: Profile the duplicate serial clusters; placeholder values need a data-entry fix, two-record clusters need per-pair review.

rules.title: Orphaned CI relationships
causes: CIs deleted without cascading relationship cleanup
Imports creating relationships against missing CIs
rules.recommendation: Report and remove relationships whose parent or child no longer resolves; correct the deleting/creating process.

rules.title: No active CI identification rules
rules.recommendation: Configure identification rules for the classes in use before any data-quality remediation - without them every source creates its own CIs.

rules.title: Large open de-duplication backlog
causes: Duplicate detection running without a remediation owner
rules.recommendation: Assign ownership of the de-duplication queue; process clusters by class starting with the largest.

rules.title: Server CIs not refreshed by discovery in 30 days
causes: Discovery schedules not covering all ranges
CIs created by import and never discovered
rules.recommendation: Cross-reference with discovery health; decide a staleness policy and lifecycle rule for undiscovered CIs.

rules.title: Server CIs without an owner
rules.recommendation: Agree the ownership model (owned_by / support_group) and backfill from an authoritative source.

rules.title: Retired CIs still marked operational
rules.recommendation: Correct the inconsistent pairs and align the retirement process to set both fields.

rules.title: CSDM not started - no business applications modelled
rules.recommendation: If service-aligned reporting is an objective, begin CSDM Crawl: model the top business applications first.

rules.title: Business applications exist but no application services are modelled
causes: CSDM stopped at the Crawl stage
rules.recommendation: Model application services for the top business applications so incidents, changes and vulnerabilities can be tied to services.

rules.title: MID Servers down or not validated
rules.recommendation: Restore each affected MID Server; every discovery, integration and orchestration path through it is degraded meanwhile.

rules.title: High ECC queue error volume
rules.recommendation: Group the errored ecc_queue records by agent and topic to isolate the failing integration or discovery pattern.

rules.title: Vulnerable items not matching CIs
causes: Scanner asset fields not aligned to CI identifiers
rules.recommendation: Correlate with CMDB duplicate and IRE findings; align scanner-to-CI matching rules with the CMDB identification strategy.

rules.title: Stale open vulnerable items
rules.recommendation: Verify scanner integration schedules and the re-open/close logic on repeat detections.

rules.title: Security incidents without an assignee
causes: Alert ingestion creating incidents without assignment rules
rules.recommendation: Review SIR assignment rules and playbook task ownership for the affected categories.

rules.title: Risks not linked to a profile
causes: Risks created directly without entity scoping
rules.recommendation: Re-link orphaned risks to profiles; without the Entity → Profile → Risk chain, scoring and roll-up are unreliable.

rules.title: Controls not linked to a profile
causes: Controls created outside the entity model
rules.recommendation: Re-link orphaned controls; verify attestation generation still covers them.

rules.title: GRC issues open beyond 90 days
rules.recommendation: Review aged issues with the risk/compliance owner; add ageing indicators.

rules.title: Open customer cases without an assignee
causes: Routing/matching rules not covering all products or accounts
rules.recommendation: Review case routing rules and agent group coverage for the affected case types.

rules.title: Customer cases ageing beyond 30 days
rules.recommendation: Cross-reference with SLA attachment; review the aged population by account and product.

rules.title: HR cases ageing beyond 30 days
rules.recommendation: Review the aged population by COE (aggregate view); check HR service SLAs and activity-set progression.

rules.title: Hardware assets not linked to CIs
causes: Asset and CI created by different sources without reconciliation
rules.recommendation: Review the asset-CI reconciliation configuration; profile unlinked assets by source and state.

rules.title: Assets without a model
rules.recommendation: Backfill models from procurement data; enforce model on the intake paths.

rules.title: Outbound HTTP failures in the last 7 days
rules.recommendation: Group the outbound log by host and status; renew credentials/certificates and add retry policies where appropriate.

rules.title: Import set rows failing transformation
rules.recommendation: Review the failing transform maps; the error distribution by import set names the broken feed.

rules.title: Elevated Flow Designer error rate
rules.recommendation: Group errored contexts by flow; open the top failing flow executions and read the failing action.

correlations.title: CMDB identification quality is degrading Vulnerability Response matching
correlations.detail: Unmatched vulnerable items and duplicate server CIs are present together. Vulnerability-to-CI matching depends on the same identifiers that are duplicated in the CMDB, so these are one underlying data-quality problem, not two.
correlations.recommendation: Treat CMDB identification remediation as the prerequisite: consolidate server identification rules and de-duplicate, then re-run vulnerability matching.

correlations.title: Discovery degradation is driving CMDB staleness
correlations.detail: MID Server availability problems coincide with a high stale-CI ratio. The staleness is a symptom; the collection outage is the cause to fix first.
correlations.recommendation: Restore MID Server availability and re-run discovery before treating staleness as a data-quality problem.

correlations.title: Catalog fulfilment chain is failing end to end
correlations.detail: Catalog items without fulfilment processes and elevated flow errors are present together - requests are stalling both where no process exists and where the process fails.
correlations.recommendation: Fix the failing flows for high-volume items first, then attach or retire the process-less items.

correlations.title: Asset-to-CI reconciliation degraded by identifier quality
correlations.detail: Hardware assets unlinked to CIs coincide with duplicated serial numbers - the reconciliation key itself is unreliable.
correlations.recommendation: Clean serial-number quality first (placeholders vs true duplicates), then re-run asset-CI reconciliation.

runbooks.title: Platform Health Check
runbooks.guidance: Start with execution patterns and queue health, then table growth, static code risk, flow outcomes and integration failures.

runbooks.title: ITSM Health Check
runbooks.guidance: Run the five process baselines in order; each feeds the findings register independently.

runbooks.title: Incident Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: Baseline incident flow first; the duplicate-signature and assignment metrics usually isolate the symptom.

runbooks.title: SLA Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: Definition activity, attach ratio, stage distribution and breach ratio cover the four standard SLA failure modes.

runbooks.title: Request Fulfilment Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: The item-without-fulfilment and RITM-per-request metrics identify whether the failure is configuration or execution; flow errors show where execution breaks.

runbooks.title: CMDB Health Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: Inventory first (the denominators), then duplicates, relationships, the IRE layer, lifecycle and CSDM alignment.

runbooks.title: CI Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: Duplicates, the identification rules that allowed them, and the freshness of the population.

runbooks.title: Discovery Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: MID and schedule health first; duplicates from discovery are usually identification-rule problems, not discovery problems.

runbooks.title: Vulnerability Response Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: The match rate depends on CMDB identity quality - always run the CMDB pair alongside the VR baseline.

runbooks.title: Security Incident Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: Baseline SIR flow, then the integration layer that feeds it.

runbooks.title: IRM Health Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: The single baseline covers the Entity → Profile → Risk → Control chain and its orphans.

runbooks.title: Customer Service Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: Case flow baseline plus SLA attachment - the two usual sources of CSM service failures.

runbooks.title: HR Service Delivery Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: Aggregate-only HR baseline: profile coverage and case flow by COE. No case content is read.

runbooks.title: Asset Management Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: Asset-CI linkage plus the serial-number quality that reconciliation depends on.

runbooks.title: Integration Diagnostic
runbooks.guidance: Outbound and import health, plus the MID layer many integrations run through.
